rows.author: A076
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM DOCUMENTARY STAMP TAX THE BORROWING AND LENDING OF SECURITIES UNDER THE AUSPICES OF THE LOCAL STOCK EXCHANGE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 180 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The exemption, will lead to the creation of other taxable transactions not possible without SBL (Securities Borrowing and Lending), like Short Selling defined as the sale of borrowed securities. Also, this will encourage the trading of other derivative instruments that require the SBL facility. Furthermore, this will bring onshore the borrowing and lending of Philippine securities happening offshore. Studies made by the PSE show that the exemption will result not to a loss of revenues for the government, but to additional and potential revenues of about Ph162 million per year from DST, Stock Transaction Taxes, VAT, Income Taxes on Commission Income, and Final Tax on Interest Income, on the additional trading transactions in the stock markeet.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2001-02-05, transmitted to on 2001-02-06 and received by the Senate on 2001

rows.abstract: This bill seeks to create the bureau of Distance Education which will be responsible in ensuring that correspondence schools shall be effective in providing quality education. "DISTANCE EDUCATION OR CORRESPONDENCE" study is an educational process inwhich a significant portion of the teaching is conducted by someone removed in place and time from the learning. Distance education may be4 delivered using printed instruction materials, video, radio, or teleconferencin g with sufficient provisionsfor valid and reliable testing and evaluation procedures.

Official watchers are the ones exposed tothe long hours of election process where vigilance is the rule and where no sleep, and if possible, no eat is a must. rows.title_full: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE IMPOSITION OF DOCUMENTARY STAMP TAX ON SECONDARY TRADING OF FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 198 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Rationale: DST is basically a transaction cost which is ultimately borne by the users of funds.  It merely adds to the cost structure that exacerbates the uncompetitivene ss of the Philippines versus its Asian neighbors. Eliminating DST on secondarytrading will greatly encourage the development of a secondary market and eventually increase tax revenues as more capital market isntruments are issued and transactions flourish.

rows.abstract: For our Muslim brothers, "HALAL" is a term that is based on the holy Quran which means "proper" and permitted. Hence, in this context, halal food is permitted by Allah (God) for Muslim consumption.
